t: This is Gardnor Road, a street in Hampstead, in the NW3 part of Camden. It's named after Thomas Gardnor, a City of London upholsterer who owned property in Hampstead and was the owner of Gardnor House. Together with his wife and his heirs, he was responsible for developing several streets in the town, and this is one of them. So the name on the sign points back to a family of builders and landowners who shaped this part of Hampstead.
